description: Finding: `Config::validate()` in `crates/imap/src/config.rs` (line 196) has no doc comment. The method enforces several invariants: non-empty listen addr, non-empty db path, max_connections > 0, TLS cert/key must both be set or both absent, tls_addr requires cert/key, and passwords must be bcrypt hashes. A reader of the code has no way to know what the method checks without reading its full body. A short doc comment listing the invariants (or at minimum calling out the security-relevant bcrypt check) would make this immediately clear.
title: imap config.validate() missing doc comment
